assets: Use case: illustration-story. Create a finished square 1536x1536 illustrated neighborhood adventure map for a preschool child's clickable web homepage. Style: richly detailed, realistic-proportioned Japanese watercolor storybook scenery, warm afternoon sunlight, natural wood and plaster textures, soft green trees, cream paper warmth, gentle dimensional perspective, consistent with an inviting painted school cutaway. Elevated almost top-down view; full neighborhood visible with clear paths connecting seven separate destinations. The UI will overlay labels, so NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARKS, no drawn UI. Exact composition needed for clickable zones: at 18% x,21% y a cozy family home with terracotta roof and garden; at 50% x,21% y a small wooden kindergarten school with panda emblem and open classroom windows; at 82% x,21% y a public park with slide, swings and trees. At 18% x,52% y a welcoming family activity center with large windows and indoor play space; at 50% x,52% y a dance studio with open cutaway showing wood floor, mirrors and a ballet barre; at 82% x,52% y a music studio with cutaway piano, guitar and music instruments. At 50% x,82% y a small travel pavilion with a globe and tiny runway/white airplane, representing world travel. Leave a small calm cream/grass patch BELOW each destination around y31%,62%,92% for HTML labels; do not place additional buildings there. Meandering stone paths connect all locations through garden greenery. Nothing scary, no skeletons, no big foreground characters. Cohesive immersive scenic painting, not a grid of isolated icons, not a dashboard or screenshot. Accurate recognizable everyday objects, inviting for a four-year-old.

Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. Create a horizontal 1536x1024 warm realistic watercolor atlas illustration for a preschool travel game showing East Asia, Taiwan, and Japan. North up. Geographic composition: Taiwan is a clearly recognizable small tapered green island centered approximately x28%,y77%; Japan is northeast, main islands Kyushu, Shikoku, Honshu and Hokkaido visibly forming their familiar curved archipelago across x65%-86%, y15%-48%; southern Japan destination near x70%,y35%. Mainland East Asian coastline and Korean peninsula should be recognizable on the left/northwest, Taiwan below the southern Chinese coast, Japan east of Korea. Sea pale turquoise with subtle watercolor grain, land gentle sage green, warm cream paper edges, realistic coastline silhouettes and organic textures. Restrained tiny landmarks: Taiwan green mountain ridge and a small red-roofed town; Japan a little Mount Fuji and cherry trees. No borders/flags or political labels. No text or letters anywhere, no numbers, no airplane, no route line, no map pins, no drawn interface: these are added as interactive HTML/SVG. Leave open ocean space between Taiwan and Japan for a flying airplane animation. Friendly Japanese watercolor picture-book atlas with natural proportions and crisp legibility, same warmth as a detailed school-garden painting. This is a travel illustration, avoid turning the islands into fantasy blobs.
